<question>
Thinking about switching from Basic to Plus. What's the monthly cost, and what would my savings rate go up to?
</question>

Reference answer:
Plus costs $5.00 a month. Your Savings Pockets would go from 0.50% APY on Basic to 2.00% APY on Plus.

[fee-changes-2026] What changed in the March 2026 fee update (effective 2026-03-01)
We updated our fees on March 1, 2026. Here's everything that changed and what stayed the same.

## What changed

- **Plus monthly fee:** from $4.00 to $5.00.
- **Plus foreign transaction fee:** from 1.5% to 1%.
- **Out-of-network ATM fee on Basic and Plus:** from $2.00 to $2.50 per withdrawal.
- **Plus free out-of-network withdrawals:** from 2 to 3 a month.

## What stayed the same

Basic is still free. Premium is still $15.00 a month with no ATM or foreign transaction fees. Card replacement, wire and cash deposit fees didn't change on any plan.

## Why we made these changes

Out-of-network ATM operators raised what they charge us, and we moved part of that cost into the fee. We lowered the Plus foreign transaction fee at the same time, so Plus members who travel pay less overall.

If the new Plus price doesn't work for you, you can move to Basic in the app. The change takes effect on your next billing date.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

## Notes

- Plus includes 3 free out-of-network ATM withdrawals each calendar month. The fee in the table applies after those.
- Premium reimburses ATM owner surcharges up to $10.00 a month.
- There are no overdraft fees ($0.00), no fees for returned transfers and no inactivity fees on any plan.
- Incoming domestic wires are free ($0.00) on every plan.
- ATM owners can add their own surcharge. That is separate from our fee.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[plan-basic] The Basic plan (effective 2026-06-01)
Basic is Tallowbrook's free plan. The monthly fee is $0.00, there's no minimum balance, and you get the same app, debit card and support as every other member.

## What's included

- **Monthly fee:** $0.00
- **ATMs:** free at BrookLink ATMs. Out-of-network withdrawals cost $2.50 each.
- **Foreign transaction fee:** 3% of the purchase amount
- **Card replacement:** $5.00
- **Expedited card shipping:** $25.00
- **Savings Pockets:** 0.50% APY
- **Cushion:** not available on Basic
- **Daily card spending limit:** $3,000
- **Daily ATM limit:** $500

## Good to know

International wires aren't available on Basic. You can still receive them. If you travel or send money abroad often, Plus or Premium will usually cost less over a year.

You can change plans any time in the app under Profile, then Plan. Upgrades start right away. Downgrades start on your next billing date.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[plan-plus] The Plus plan (effective 2026-06-01)
Plus costs $5.00 a month. It's built for people who use their card a lot away from BrookLink ATMs or spend some time abroad, and it adds Cushion and a higher savings rate.

## What's included

- **Monthly fee:** $5.00
- **ATMs:** free at BrookLink ATMs, plus 3 free out-of-network withdrawals a month. After that it's $2.50 per withdrawal.
- **Foreign transaction fee:** 1% of the purchase amount
- **Card replacement:** free
- **Expedited card shipping:** $25.00
- **Savings Pockets:** 2.00% APY
- **Cushion:** fee-free coverage up to $50.00 on debit card purchases
- **Daily card spending limit:** $5,000
- **Daily ATM limit:** $1,000

## Good to know

Plus includes outgoing international wires for $35.00 each. Your card is plastic, like Basic. Upgrade to Premium if you want the metal card.

You can change plans any time in the app under Profile, then Plan. Upgrades start right away. Downgrades start on your next billing date.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[plans-compare] Compare plans: features and limits (effective 2026-06-01)
All three plans come with a Visa debit card, the Tallowbrook app, BrookPay transfers to other members, Savings Pockets and support around the clock. They differ in fees, limits and a few features.

| Feature | Basic | Plus | Premium |
|---|---|---|---|
| Card | plastic | plastic | metal |
| Savings APY | 0.50% | 2.00% | 3.75% |
| Cushion | not available | up to $50.00 | up to $200 |
| Daily card spending | $3,000 | $5,000 | $10,000 |
| Daily ATM withdrawals | $500 | $1,000 | $1,500 |
| Daily ACH transfers out | $2,500 | $5,000 | $10,000 |
| Outgoing international wires | not available | yes | yes |
| Emergency card abroad | no | no | yes |

Fees are listed in the article "Fees for all plans". This page covers features and limits only.

## Which plan fits

Basic suits people who mostly use BrookLink ATMs and don't travel. Plus suits people who want Cushion and a better savings rate for a small monthly fee. Premium suits frequent travelers and people with larger balances, since the savings rate and the missing foreign fees can more than cover the monthly fee.

You can switch plans in the app at any time.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.

[savings-apy-basic-v2] Savings rate on Basic (effective 2026-06-01)
On the Basic plan, Savings Pockets earn 0.50% APY, effective June 1, 2026.

## Details

- The rate applies to combined pocket balances up to $100,000. Anything above earns 0.10% APY.
- Interest compounds daily and is paid monthly.
- Your main balance doesn't earn interest. Move money to a pocket to earn it.
- There's no minimum balance and no limit on withdrawals.

## Rates are variable

We may change the rate. We'll email you at least 30 days before a decrease.

## How to start earning

Tap Savings, then New pocket, and move money in from your main balance. Moving money in and out is instant and free. Interest for each month is paid into the pocket on the first business day of the next month.

## If you change plans

Your pockets start earning the new plan's rate on the day the change takes effect. Upgrades take effect right away and downgrades on your next billing date.

## Earn more

Plus members earn 2.00% APY on the same balance.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

## Details

- Interest compounds daily and is paid monthly.
- Your main balance doesn't earn interest. Move money to a pocket to earn it.
- There's no minimum balance and no limit on withdrawals.

## Rates are variable

We may change the rate. We'll email you at least 30 days before a decrease.

## How to start earning

Tap Savings, then New pocket, and move money in from your main balance. Moving money in and out is instant and free. Interest for each month is paid into the pocket on the first business day of the next month.

## If you change plans

Your pockets start earning the new plan's rate on the day the change takes effect. Upgrades take effect right away and downgrades on your next billing date.

## Earn more

Premium members earn 3.75% APY on the same balance.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[savings-pockets] How Savings Pockets work (effective 2026-06-01)
Savings Pockets are separate balances inside your account that earn interest. You can have up to 10 of them, each with its own name and goal.

## Create a pocket

Tap Savings, then New pocket. Name it, set a goal if you like, and move money in.

## Moving money

Moving money between your main balance and your pockets is instant and free, every day. There's no limit on how many times you can withdraw from a pocket.

## Interest

All your pockets earn the APY for your plan: 0.50% on Basic, 2.00% on Plus and 3.75% on Premium. Rates are variable.

## Spending from a pocket

Your card spends from your main balance, not from pockets. Move money back first.

## Closing a pocket

Tap the pocket, then Close. Any money and accrued interest move to your main balance.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[savings-rate-change-2026] Savings rate change, June 2026 (effective 2026-06-01)
On June 1, 2026, we changed the rates on Savings Pockets. Here are the old and new rates.

| Plan | Before | From the change |
|---|---|---|
| Basic | 0.75% | 0.50% |
| Plus | 2.50% | 2.00% |
| Premium | 4.10% | 3.75% |

## Why

Our savings rates follow wider interest rates, which came down over the past year. We kept the gap between plans the same.

## What you need to do

Nothing. Your pockets started earning the new rate automatically. Interest earned before the change was calculated at the old rate.

## Notice

We emailed every member at least 30 days before the change.

## Balance cap

The cap didn't change. Plan rates apply up to $100,000.

## Thinking about switching plans?

The rate you earn depends on your plan. Upgrading takes effect immediately, so your pockets start earning the higher rate the same day. Compare plans in the app before you decide.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

How to decide:
- A claim is supported when the reference answer or a current source article states it, or it follows directly from them. Rewording, writing "$5.00" as "$5", and leaving details out are fine.
- A claim is unsupported when it adds a number, fee, limit, time, plan detail, product, step or rule that the reference and the current sources do not state, or states one differently. One unsupported claim is enough to fail "grounded".
- Check every number against the plan it is about. A value that belongs to another plan is wrong.
- An article marked as superseded shows an old version of a policy. It does not support a claim, unless the question asks what changed.
- Courtesy text such as "message us in the app if you need more help" is not a factual claim.

Checklist:
- correct: Does the answer agree with the reference answer on everything the question asks (amounts, limits, times, plan names, steps, and whether something is allowed), with nothing that contradicts it? If no reference answer is given, judge this against the sources.
- grounded: Is every factual claim in the answer supported by the reference answer or the current source articles? Answer no if the answer states any number, fee, limit, time, plan detail, product, step or rule that they do not support.

Reply with a single JSON object and nothing else. It must have exactly these keys: correct, grounded.
Each value must be an object with "pass" (true or false) and "reason" (one short sentence).
Example of the shape:
{"correct": {"pass": true, "reason": "..."}, "grounded": {"pass": true, "reason": "..."}}
